foundingBar.text: Founding Member sign-ups are open: the first 100 get a numbered badge, free. Puntr launches {{launch}}.

meta.title: Puntr | Predict smarter. Prove it.
meta.description: A Community-First Platform for South African sports fans. Picks locked at kick-off, graded automatically and kept forever. 18+.
meta.ogDescription: Every pick is locked at kick-off, graded automatically and kept forever. Build a record people can trust. 18+.
meta.orgDescription: A Community-First Platform for South African sports fans: locked, auto-graded, public tipster records. 18+.

fixtures.title: A sneak peek into the Puntr experience
fixtures.body: Sample match cards across competitions and sports. These are design examples, not scheduled fixtures or available markets.

leaderboard.title: What the leaderboard can look like
leaderboard.body: Sample profiles and performance figures to demonstrate the ranking layout. No real member data is shown.

insights.title: Inside the Insights experience
insights.body: Illustrative match analysis, visual performance trends and a multi-source news feed preview.
insights.chartNote: Example percentages only — not Puntr member performance.
insights.newsBody: Example publisher cards show how aggregated coverage could appear. No live articles are being fetched here.
insights.refresh: Planned refresh schedule: every 24 hours at 12:00 SAST

gate.title: {{feature}} opens at launch
gate.body: This part of Puntr goes live for everyone on Tuesday 1 December 2026. Until then you can sharpen your picks in Practice Mode.
gate.preview: Preview: you can see this before launch because your account has admin or Early access rights. Members see it from 1 December 2026.
